# X6 R24 — Recurrent signed-Port grants and exact shared-threshold future quotient

Date: 2026-11-19. Task: RS-X6-NATIVE-TIME-DYNAMICS, publication TP2-91D4A7C2F63805BE21A3.
Scientific input: frozen P000 V5 at enterprise-math@a72226e2430ffa4786321ac86e7f0c599d5f0389:p000_reality_foundation.json; taskbook at @f41c2690daba467ecbde99615a1337e67be46ffd:research_tasks/RS_X6_NATIVE_TIME_DYNAMICS_20260906.md.
Status: CONDITIONAL_AUTHOR_PROOF / EXACT_BOOLEAN_BRC_PASS / NOT_REVIEWED / NATIVE_EVENT_ADMISSION_PENDING.
Lineage: continues R23 (shared threshold, one-time frame-dependent grant). Research lane attribution: Research2 / historical EM-X6-214D9C. GitHub publication is not a fresh native CLAIM, Result, or Review.

## Model and observer
Let m,q,u be positive integers. Choose m disjoint two-Cell lanes in a chart of the affine six-axis X6 Cell torsor. Each B_i is an intact triadic source with a conserved hidden frame bit theta_i in {0,1}; the two frames are distinct valid triadic frames sharing the permitted E1 Port. Source identity and internal frame provenance persist.

Each B_i has exactly two alternating successful native signed-Port actions: b_i^+ takes it from the first Cell to the second along +E1, and b_i^- returns it along -E1. Its motion is repeatable indefinitely. On the completion of each return b_i^-, it grants one unit of a shared credit pool precisely if theta_i=1 and fewer than u such grants have already been issued by this source. After the first u completed cycles, it may still cycle but makes no further grants. The resource balance r is capped at q; all B motions have zero resource cost. A distinct A source on its own vacant two-Cell lane has a single A^+ event costing q units and then cannot move again. Every Cell movement is of an intact triad, and time is the order of actual successful relation changes, not a seventh spatial direction.

The observer records the complete successful source-identity/signed-Port word, including order and the empty word. It sees neither the frame bits, failed attempts, resource ledger nor physical duration. All 2^m initial frame assignments have identical public Cell placement, identical initial zero credit, identical successful one-step event set, and the same provenance-preserving event alphabet. This is a DECLARED conditional Cell/Link/Port resource law; P000's closure premise does not supply the native grant rule.

Define L_h(theta) as the set of successful words of length at most h. Write S(theta)={i:theta_i=1}, and put t=ceil(q/u). An empty binomial sum equals zero.

## Theorem R24.1 — exact minimal joint residual after repeatable grants
For all m,q,u>=1:

(1) For every h<=2q, L_h(theta) is independent of theta.

(2) At h=2q+1, and for EVERY larger h, the future-language equivalence classes are: one joint class for ALL S with |S|<t, and a distinct singleton class for EACH S with |S|>=t. In particular if t>m the entire initial fiber remains equivalent for arbitrary future.

(3) The exact number of classes and the minimal fixed-length additional memory on this initial fiber are

    C(m,q,u)=1+SUM_{j=t}^m binomial(m,j),
    b_{2q+1}=ceil(log2 C(m,q,u)) bits,

with b_h=0 for h<=2q. For h>=2q+1 the same b persists.

**Proof.** A requires q positive grant events. Each productive return b_i^- follows its matching outward b_i^+, so any successful word containing A has at least 2q B events before A and total length at least 2q+1. All shorter words contain B actions only, and every legal B motion is independent of hidden frame assignments; this proves (1).

For a q-element MULTISET J of indices, let a_i be its multiplicities, so sum a_i=q. Form the explicitly signed event word w_J consisting of a_i complete b_i^+b_i^- excursions for each i (ordered arbitrarily), followed by A^+. It succeeds exactly when every index occurring in J lies in S and a_i<=u. Indeed every such excursion before saturation credits one unit if and only if its source is positive, and q credits are needed. Any successful word containing A must have accumulated q positive returns, each source contributing at most u; discarding any intervening nonproductive or extra B actions leaves one of these q-multisets as a legal grant certificate.

If |S|u<q, no A event is possible at any time. These frame assignments therefore share the complete B-only language. If |S|u>=q, some q-multiset J exists with a_i<=u and support contained in S. Moreover for EVERY i in S, such a multiset can be chosen with a_i>=1: first reserve one occurrence of i, then distribute q-1 among the remaining available slots (total capacity |S|u-1>=q-1). Thus the family of successful grant-certificate words uniquely determines S by taking the union of their supports. Any two distinct S with |S|>=t have different such families and hence different L_{2q+1}; a low-cardinality S has no such word. Conversely equal S give identical controllers, and all low-cardinality sets have no A at any horizon. This proves (2), including stabilization. Counting one low class and all distinct high sets proves (3), and a class index attains the information-theoretic bit bound. QED.

## Consequences and contrast with R23
- u=1 exactly reproduces the R23 q-subset class count, despite the B sources being able to move around and return. What matters to this observer is the cap of *positive resource grants*, not the number of geometric moves.
- u>=q yields t=1 and C=2^m: even with ONE shared threshold-q consumer, the complete m-bit hidden frame vector is eventually recoverable. The individual signed-Port word (b_i^+b_i^-)^q A^+ succeeds precisely if theta_i=1.
- m=4,q=4: u=1 -> 2 classes/1 bit; u=2 -> 12 classes/4 bits; u=3 -> 12 classes/4 bits; u=4 -> 16 classes/4 bits. The transition in minimal information is discrete.
- If mu<q, A cannot act for ANY frame vector; all future words coincide and the correct answer is 0 bits, not a false finite distinguishing-depth claim.
- The full typed controller state (Cell, theta, per-source grant count, shared balance, A-used) is sufficient for future events but is not minimal on the declared initial observer fiber. A spatial return B_i^+B_i^- does not make the typed state return: credit and grant count may change.

## Exact reproducible evidence
Source: x6_recurrent_signed_credit_brc_verify_r24.js
Output: x6_recurrent_signed_credit_brc_results_r24.json

The checker computes exact deterministic successful-labelled-language signatures via depth recursion with structural interning; it compares all 2^m frame configurations at horizons 2q and 2q+1. It separately enumerates all ordered q-source grant-certificate witnesses and checks their actual resource updates. Domains: 29 triples m=1..4, q=1..min(m+1,4), u=1..q. Observed: 270 initial frame assignments, 84,642 memoized labelled horizon-state evaluations, 23,582 explicit signed excursion-certificate replays; zero failures. The executable result JSON records every triple. The symbolic theorem holds for arbitrary positive m,q,u in this conditional controller; the test is finite and independent of a native physical law.

## Native transfer and next open problem
Locate and authenticate a genuine TRIADIC_CLOSURE_E whole-triad signed Port transition and its Link/Port grant/cost/refresh ledger. Determine whether the return-cycle replenishment and per-source grant saturation operations are admitted in the exact frozen task scope; record an explicit event-to-event correspondence and its preservation of joint provenance. Next extend the theorem to two A-like consumers (multiple irreversible spends), where replenishment after a first spend can produce genuinely new future-language classes. Keep conditional author proof, exact checker scope, and independent native Review separate.
